label: Triangle multiplication, outgoing and incoming
context: Explains AlphaFold's triangle multiplicative update. Left half: a 6x6 grid = the pair representation z (rows i, columns j), cells pale grey with faint random shading. Right half: 6 residues as circles on an arc labelled 1..6. Phase 1 'pick a pair (i, j)': highlight cell (i=2, j=5) in dark ink on the grid and draw the edge 2-5 on the right. Phase 2 'outgoing: combine row i with row j': highlight the whole row 2 in blue and the whole row 5 in rust; then sweep k = 1..6: for each k, flash cell (2,k) blue and cell (5,k) rust, draw on the right the two edges 2->k (blue) and 5->k (rust) forming a triangle with 2-5, and grow a small bar next to the grid labelled 'sum over k of a_ik * b_jk' that accumulates one segment per k; caption 'outgoing: edges leaving i and j, multiplied channel by channel and summed over every third residue k'. Phase 3 'gate and add': the accumulated bar passes through a small box labelled 'LayerNorm, Linear, x gate g_ij' and flows into cell (2,5) which pulses; caption 'z_ij <- z_ij + g_ij * Linear(LN(sum_k a_ik * b_jk))'. Phase 4 'incoming: columns instead of rows': same as phase 2 but highlight column 2 (blue) and column 5 (rust), edges k->2 and k->5 on the right; caption 'incoming: edges arriving at i and j'. Phase 5 'every pair at once': all cells pulse in a wave, caption 'done for all N^2 pairs: a matrix product per channel, N^3 work'. Canvas is responsive: width anywhere from 340 to 900 px, height 420 px; derive every size and position from width and height, keep all text at least 11 px and fully inside the canvas, and on narrow widths stack or shrink rather than overlap. Loop forever on a cycle of 14 to 20 s with smooth easing between phases. White background. Ink #04204B for text and outlines, blue #0B4FC0 and rust #B4552F as the two accent colours, light grey #EEF1F6 for empty cells. Put a one-line phase caption at the top centre that changes with the phase. No title inside the canvas (the card has one). Plain sans-serif labels.

spec.title: Triangle multiplication, outgoing and incoming
spec.caption: One pair entry z_ij is rewritten from two rows (outgoing) or two columns (incoming) of z. A third residue k closes a triangle at each step, and the products are summed over k.
